description: This Go source file provides utility functions for internationalization (i18n) within a workflow system. It includes functions for generating cache keys, hashing and normalizing text, managing environment-based configuration for providers and models, and utility string functions.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a cache namespace string based on workflow version, engine, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a hash-based cache key from namespace, source language, target language, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns SHA256 hash of normalized input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns SHA256 hash of given byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims and collapses whitespace in a string.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID from relative path and text hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits a string into leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a byte is whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error and terminates the program if the error is non-nil.
